title: Shop calendar (store.calendar)
summary: Internal Operations table holding one row per calendar day for the Valdena shop, with an is_open flag and an optional local event_name. Catalog declares daily grain, coverage from 2022-01-01 with no end date, and about 1,500 rows. It is accessed through the warehouse, and was last refreshed 2026-10-10. It was not sampled, so row completeness and event history are unverified.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Local event that day, if any

schema.notes: Column list taken from catalog entry only; no wiki page documents the table.

spatial.notes: Single shop location in northern Italy per use-case spec; no location code in the columns.

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: Catalog classification 'internal'; no licence field in catalog entry internal.store.calendar.

documentation_excerpts: Opening days, closures and local events for the shop. (catalog description)
Whether the shop was open (is_open column description)
Local event that day, if any (event_name column description)
quality_notes: Row count vs window: catalog says row_count_approx 1500, but temporal_coverage 2022-01-01 to open end implies about 1,745 calendar days to 2026-10-14. Roughly 250 days may be missing, or the table is not one row per day. Not verified (no sample taken; warehouse_sql only).

Refresh is weekly while grain is daily; days after the last refresh (2026-10-10) may be missing from the recent window, which runs to 2026-03-31 in the use case, so this is only a problem for the tail if the table is incomplete.
No wiki backlinks found for store.calendar (get_catalog_entry wiki_backlinks is empty). Opening-hours change history is undocumented.
event_name: no documentation on completeness, or on whether values are historical records or planned events; unknown.
is_open does not say whether a closed day was a holiday closure, a shop decision or a missing record; cannot be separated from zero sales without sales rows.

Till outage 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10 (wiki till_migration_2024, edited 2024-03-12): no sales rows exist for those days and should be treated as missing, not zero. The calendar's is_open value for that period is not documented, so it is unknown whether the calendar marks those days as closed or open.
No wiki page for the calendar was found, so the wiki does not confirm or contradict the catalog's coverage claim.

provenance.claim: Table is daily grain, owned by Store Operations, steward Elena Russo, status active, internal, no PII, with three columns calendar_date, is_open, event_name
Temporal coverage 2022-01-01 with open end, weekly refresh, last refreshed 2026-10-10, row_count_approx 1500
2024 till replacement 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10: no sales recorded, treat as missing not zero; sales.daily_by_product has no rows for those days
Access via warehouse_sql, open to analytics roles

unknowns: Actual row count and whether every day from 2022-01-01 is present; not sampled
Whether is_open is false on the 2024 till outage days
Whether event_name is complete and historical or planned
Whether public holidays are flagged in the table or only in event_name
Whether opening-hours history changed over time (no documentation)
Whether the warehouse connection is currently reachable and the caller has access (not tested)
Licence and retention policy beyond 'internal' not stated
Coverage of recent window after last weekly refresh (2026-10-10) for dates up to 2026-03-31 has no gap evidence either way
